Get the list of current and previous companies that are relationship_type OF company_id.

Returns a dictionary of shape:
{
    "current": List[{"company_id": <company_id>, "company_name": <company_name>}],
    "previous": List[{"company_id": <company_id>, "company_name": <company_name>}]
}.

Get the list of current and previous ticker identification triples that are relationship_type OF company_id.

Returns a dictionary of shape {“current”: List[{“company_id”: <company_id>, “security_id”: <security_id>, “trading_item_id”: <trading_item_id>}], “previous”: List[{“company_id”: <company_id>, “security_id”: <security_id>, “trading_item_id”: <trading_item_id>}]}.
